_note: Fantasy Six Pack / Flock Fantasy RB ARCHETYPE study, transcribed from the YouTube video below. This is NOT a ranked board — it is an archetype label per RB plus that archetype's historical hit rate, so entries deliberately have no 'overall' and no 'posRank' (they cast no vote in the board's consensus rank; they only add reasoning to the research prompt). RB ONLY: absence from this file means the player was not covered, NOT that he was ranked low. Notes are HIS stated reasoning, paraphrased from what he said — do not extend past it.
_method: Sample: top-20-ADP RBs, 2015-2025 (220 RBs). Buckets: RB in his prime = under 27 and/or already an RB1 finish; trusty veteran = year 7+ or age 27+; breakout candidate = year 3 or younger with no RB1 finish. Baseline over all top-20 RBs: 41.8% return on ADP, 17.7% miss 6+ games, ~25% boom (18+ PPG or beat ADP by 10 spots), 19% bust (lose 10+ ADP spots), 21.4% just 'fine'. RBs in their prime have the best return rate, the fewest injuries and the fewest 'fine' seasons. Trusty veterans bust least but get injured most and return on ADP least — 2 of every 3 disappoint. Breakout candidates stay healthy and return near the prime rate, but bust second-most and boom least because the market pushes them up. Value over replacement at RB is exponential — 5-7 RBs a year are far and away the best, so hitting on two is a league-sized edge. RB league-winners come almost entirely from rounds 1-5; rounds 7-9 produced none in 8 seasons.
